name: MarketHoursGate
mechanic: Swaps only clear during standard U.S. market hours; every other window reverts.
plain: This hook gates every swap on the pool behind the regular U.S. stock market schedule: 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern time, Monday through Friday. Attempt a trade outside that window - nights, weekends, or before the open - and the swap reverts instead of executing. The check reads the block's timestamp at the moment of execution, so it can't be front-run by timing a transaction ahead of the open.
rules: Swaps are only allowed Monday-Friday, 09:30-16:00 America/New_York.
Any swap attempted outside that window reverts in beforeSwap.
The time check uses block.timestamp at execution, not the time the transaction was submitted.
